author: H. T.
quote: Anne is a truly wonderful, caring, and professional counsellor. She has such a gentle, warm, and understanding approach that makes my daughter feel safe, comfortable, and supported. I am so grateful for the patience, kindness, and professionalism Anne has shown throughout the counselling sessions. She has a special way of connecting with my daughter, making her feel listened to and understood without any pressure or judgement. Gradually, my daughter has become more comfortable opening up and expressing her thoughts and feelings, which means so much to me as a parent. It is reassuring to know that my daughter has someone like Anne who genuinely cares, listens with compassion, and creates a safe space for her to talk about things that may be difficult to share. Anne’s gentle encouragement and professional guidance have made a real difference, and I truly appreciate the positive impact she has had on my daughter. I would highly recommend Anne to any parent looking for a kind, patient, and professional counsellor for their child. We are very grateful for all her support and the trust she has helped build with my daughter.

author: E. S.
quote: I am currently going through the assessment process with Anne as my therapist. We were meant to go through the assessment quite easily, but it turns out I had a lot more to talk about than I realised and have needed to extend the assessment until we've covered all the first steps. I didn't know what to expect for my first time attending therapy, but Anne has made it such a calm and comfortable experience. She is very attentive and gives me time to explain myself. She ensures that she understands what I'm talking about fully without rushing me. I always feel at ease talking with Anne and I'm so happy to be working with her.
